name: Grappler
summary: A general feat for grappling, with a Strength or Dexterity increase.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.text: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

benefits.name: Punch and Grab
benefits.text: When you hit a creature with an {ref:glossary/unarmed-strike} as part of the {ref:glossary/attack} action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

benefits.name: Attack Advantage
benefits.text: You have {ref:glossary/advantage} on attack rolls against a creature {ref:condition/grappled} by you.

benefits.name: Fast Wrestler
benefits.text: You don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature {ref:condition/grappled} by you if the creature is your size or smaller.
